model_name: ST18-no-pairing + explicitly selected Wang2009 Eq11 task variant
scope: finite single-j Hamiltonian eigenstates and fixed-H state-mapping discriminants, no experimental fit/mode identification
outputs: lowest three eigenvalues at each I with energy-order labels only
R distribution, j-component RMS, <R^2>, <I dot j>/I(I+1)
candidate mapping differences at same I without changing H or data
conditional oldEq3 sensitivity as separate variant if run
units: hbar, MeV, hbar2/MeV; g coefficient dimensionless, physicalg not computed
validation_plan: intrinsic Hermiticity/trace and D2 subspace closure
<R²> from matrix vs distribution and Casimir identity
full finite D2 basis without invented truncation; quote numerical residuals
missing_for_experiment: true response/Cov, measured counts/lifetime/g values, effectivegj/gR, complete EMoperator, original producer code
prohibited: state ordinal called verified wobbling/SP by construction
calculated g coefficient called measured g
source formula choice called author code reproduction

observational_crosscheck.kind: post-definition central diagnostic, not blind held-out model selection
observational_crosscheck.source: Lv2022 SI Table1 with inherited review/actual original reading
invariants: raw counts and published levels fixed
common energy offset cancels in splitting
observational_crosscheck.boundary: source model parameters may already use energies in earlier calibration; do not advertise this as prospective independent validation
